I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on November 3, 2025.

Two sources back that date: Moss's Nov 2, 2025 Coastal digest and Bettina's own cutover recap. I also told her that, per her recap, she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. She can use that date if the coverage tracker needs the day-to-day handover instead of the official one.
